title: Freshen Record
description: Authoring-substrate schema for the tracker comment recording an acquired work-unit freshen pass. The record is a log entry on the ticket, not a runtime artifact.

work_unit.description: Common envelope - threads to work unit.

grounded_against.description: Current substrate the freshen pass grounded against.

commit.description: Repository commit or immutable source identifier consulted during grounding.

grounded_at.description: Timestamp when the grounding pass was performed.

tracker_state.description: Tracker state consulted for the ticket body and dependency graph.

staleness_finding.description: Present finding naming what was stale or thin and what changed, or stating that grounding found the body current.

graph_finding.description: Present finding for every dependency-graph facet on the acquired unit.

blockers.description: Finding for blocking work-units and their current state.

blocked.description: Finding for work-units blocked by this unit and their current state.

epic_membership.description: Finding for parent epic membership or absence.

siblings.description: Finding for sibling or duplicate work-unit state.

milestone.description: Finding for milestone currency or absence.

labels.description: Finding for label accuracy against current tracker state.

disposition.description: Exactly one typed freshen disposition selected before any re-craft.
